title: Supernova's Core
description: A datapack that contains some common functionality for Supernova Empires modpacks
body:
Supernova’s Core is a core datapack that provides shared systems and gameplay changes for the Supernova Empires modpacks.

It acts as the foundation of the Supernova ecosystem, adding consistent mechanics, progression tweaks, and balance changes that unify all Supernova modpacks.

## Features

Supernova’s Core introduces a wide range of core functionality, including:

🔧 Recipe changes
Rebalanced and custom crafting recipes for better progression and modpack balance.

🏆 Custom advancements
New advancement trees designed to guide players through the Supernova progression.

🏷️ Tags & integration
Extensive item, block, and entity tags to improve compatibility between mods.

🎁 Loot table modifications
Adjusted chest, mob, and structure loot to fit the Supernova gameplay vision.

⚙️ Core systems for modpacks
Shared mechanics and datapack logic used across all Supernova Empires packs.

🧩 Miscellaneous tweaks
Quality-of-life improvements, balance changes, and technical datapack features.
